fact: Digital Policy Alert records that Egypt's Cloud First Policy, adopted by the Supreme Council of Digital Society on 13 March 2024, entered into force on 22 August 2024 and requires data classified top secret or secret to be hosted exclusively within Egypt.

Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology says the state's strategy for digital transformation and strengthening digital sovereignty includes a nationally developed biometric verification and e-signature system, built locally with national expertise so the state owns its core digital components.

Communications and IT Minister Raafat Hindy said Egypt's digital sovereignty strategy rests on five pillars: sovereign digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, data protection and technology talent.
